answer_1.quote: A typical simultaneous translation system consists of an auto-speech-recognition (ASR) system that transcribes the source speech into source streaming text, and a machine translation (MT) system that performs the translation from the source into the target text.

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU score to evaluate translation quality, and Average Lagging to measure latency.

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 200 sentences ... and ask human translators to translate them in the way that they do simultaneous interpretation. ... We further ask human translators to evaluate the quality of MU and MU++. They rated each translation in Bad, OK and Good based on the translations' adequacy, correctness and fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters assigned a quality label (Bad, OK, Good) based on adequacy, correctness, and fluency of the translation.
